canonical_name: Erdos-Ko-Rado maximum size of a uniform intersecting family
literal_source_claim: 相交族的最大大小 (maximum size of an intersecting family)
canonical_statement: For all natural numbers n and r with 1 <= r <= n / 2, the maximum cardinality of an intersecting family of r-element subsets of the labeled ground set Fin n is choose(n - 1, r - 1): a star attains this cardinality and every such family has at most this cardinality.
canonical_claim: For all natural numbers n and r with 1 <= r <= n / 2, the maximum cardinality of an intersecting family of r-element subsets of the labeled ground set Fin n is choose(n - 1, r - 1): a star attains this cardinality and every such family has at most this cardinality.

canonical_formal_target.candidate_type: for a finite family A of r-subsets of Fin n, if A is intersecting and r <= n / 2, then card A <= choose (n - 1) (r - 1)
canonical_formal_target.candidate_relationship: exact candidate for the standard uniform upper-bound variant; weaker than a maximum-with-attainment or equality-characterization root and only a specialization of original Theorem 1's antichain plus at-most-size premises; fixed-size distinct members are automatically incomparable

domain_and_universes: n r : Nat; A : Finset (Finset (Fin n)); the target and all predicates are propositions in Lean universe 0.
quantifiers: every n r : Nat with 1 <= r <= n / 2
some attaining family A : Finset (Finset (Fin n))
every bounded family A : Finset (Finset (Fin n))
hypotheses: the universally bounded family is intersecting
every member of the universally bounded family has cardinality r
conclusion: There exists an intersecting r-uniform family with card choose(n - 1, r - 1), and every intersecting r-uniform family has card at most choose(n - 1, r - 1).
